$comment: BIRD dev questions on superhero (task 11b, chat 20.10), from BIRD's dev.json as written (question, evidence, SQL: CC BY-SA 4.0). Each has a hand-written plan whose result must equal the result of BIRD's SQL on the same database (tools/bird_eval.py --plans); compare says how: value (one number, AVG within the 2 decimals the compiler rounds to), set, bag, or ordered, over the columns named. gaps: questions the plan language cannot state, with the reason, and where one exists the plan the compiler refuses.

questions.question: Please list all the superpowers of 3-D Man.
questions.evidence: 3-D Man refers to superhero_name = '3-D Man'; superpowers refers to power_name
questions.sql: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = '3-D Man'

readings.label: r
readings.asked: Please list all the superpowers of 3-D Man.

questions.question: Please list the full names of all the superheroes with over 15 super powers.
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.full_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id GROUP BY T1.full_name HAVING COUNT(T2.power_id) > 15

readings.label: r
readings.asked: Please list the full names of all the superheroes with over 15 super powers.

questions.question: How many superheroes have blue eyes?
questions.evidence: blue eyes refers to colour = 'Blue' and eye_colour_id = colour.id;
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue'

readings.label: r
readings.asked: How many superheroes have blue eyes?

questions.question: What is the average height of the superheroes from Marvel Comics?

questions.sql: SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

readings.label: r

questions.question: What is the total number of superheroes without full name?

questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL

questions.question: Among the superheroes with height from 170 to 190, list the names of the superheroes with no eye color.
questions.evidence: height from 170 to 190 refers to height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190; no eye color refers to colour = 'No Colour'
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND T2.colour = 'No Colour'

readings.label: r
readings.asked: Among the superheroes with height from 170 to 190, list the names of the superheroes with no eye color.

questions.question: Which power do superheroes have the most of?
questions.evidence: power that superheroes have the most refers to MAX(COUNT(power_name))
questions.sql: SELECT T2.power_name FROM hero_power AS T1 INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.power_name ORDER BY COUNT(T1.hero_id) DESC LIMIT 1

readings.label: r
readings.asked: Which power do superheroes have the most of?

questions.question: Who is the tallest superhero?

questions.question: How many female superheroes are in Marvel Comics?

questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1.gender_id = T3.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND T3.gender = 'Female'

readings.asked: How many female superheroes are in Marvel Comics?

gaps.question: Please list the superhero names of all the superheroes that have blue eyes and blond hair.
gaps.sql: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' AND T3.colour = 'Blond'
gaps.reason: the colour table joined twice (eye colour and hair colour): a plan joins a table once (duplicate_table). Needs a table joined under two roles, an alias per relation

readings.label: r
readings.asked: Please list the superhero names of all the superheroes that have blue eyes and blond hair.

gaps.question: Rank heroes published by Marvel Comics by their height in descending order.
gaps.sql: SELECT superhero_name, height_cm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS HeightRank FROM superhero INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
gaps.reason: a rank over the rows (RANK() OVER): the plan language has no window function; ORDER BY gives the order, not the rank number

gaps.question: What is the percentage of superheroes who act in their own self-interest or make decisions based on their own moral code? Indicate how many of the said superheroes were published by Marvel Comics.
gaps.sql: SELECT (CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero)), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN alignment AS T3 ON T3.id = T1.alignment_id WHERE T3.alignment = 'Bad'
gaps.reason: a percentage of all superheroes and a count under a condition in one row: arithmetic between aggregates, a subquery for the whole count, and CASE; none is in the plan language
